prompt:
Write a 3P update for the "Mobile Team" covering the dates March 1-7, 2024. The update must use the strict 3P format with an emoji at the start, the team name and dates in parentheses, then three sections: Progress, Plans, and Problems. Each section should be 1-3 concise sentences focusing on data-driven content and including metrics if possible. Do not use any formatting other than plain text as follows:

[emoji] Mobile Team (March 1-7, 2024)
Progress: ...
Plans: ...
Problems: ...

Make it succinct enough to read in under 60 seconds. Use a fun emoji representing the team vibe. The tone should be matter-of-fact and for leadership and executives. No bullet points, no links, no extra prose.

Output the update as a plain text markdown file named exactly "3p-update.md".
